summary: The model substantially diverges from the approved target. Facial construction, anatomy, dorsal shields, and surface treatment do not match. Arm clearance and every foot claw cannot be verified from the supplied captures and therefore fail. The supplied deterministic report has no blockers and one warning; visual review identifies blockers.

findings.message: Visual finding: the rectangular head, stacked rounded limb segments, narrow chest, tiny hands, and short segmented tail differ substantially from the target's integrated reptilian anatomy, elongated head, muscular torso, and sweeping tail. The target's layered armor and yellow fissures are not clearly reproduced.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild the primary anatomy and silhouette against the approved target before refining surface detail.

findings.message: Visual finding: the face reads as a rectangular slab with broad rectangular brow pieces and projecting horizontal mouth plates. A coherent reptilian crown, muzzle, jaw, vents, and visible paired eyes cannot be verified. Approximate brow symmetry does not establish correct orientation of all facial parts.
findings.recommendation: Reconstruct the tapered skull and integrated muzzle and jaw; expose both eyes and vents in unobstructed close-ups.

findings.message: Visual finding: shoulder attachments are visible, but close-ups crop the lower arms and hands, and the review panel obscures part of the right-side inspection. Crowded overlaps around the shoulder, torso plates, and arm segments prevent verification of continuous clearance below the shoulders.
findings.recommendation: Capture each complete arm from shoulder through fingertips with the torso boundary visible; correct any penetration revealed.

findings.message: Visual finding: both foot close-ups frame the lower legs and crop out the claws. Wide views suggest three front projections on each foot and rear projections in profile, but cannot establish that every claw points correctly and is neither buried, sideways, nor blunt.
findings.recommendation: Recapture each entire foot from above and from the side, showing all three front claws and the rear claw from root to tip.

findings.message: Visual finding: the dorsal assembly reads as overlapping elongated flat plates with small pointed edges. Seven distinct angular shattered storm shields cannot be counted or verified, and the target's broad fractured shield silhouettes are absent.
findings.recommendation: Create seven individually readable, broad angular shields with broken contours and visible fracture structure; capture an unobstructed rear three-quarter view.

findings.message: Supplied deterministic finding: height/depth ratio is 1.2747928990859996, below the 1.35 review threshold. The screenshots nevertheless show an upright stance without arm support.
findings.recommendation: Review body depth and tail contribution to the measured ratio while preserving the upright stance.

criteria.reason: Anatomy, facial construction, proportions, tail shape, armor, and defining dorsal silhouette substantially differ from the approved target.
The slab-like facial assembly does not form the target's coherent reptilian face; correct orientation of crown, muzzle, jaw, vents, and eyes cannot all be verified.
Shoulder attachments are visible, but cropping, occlusion, and overlapping forms prevent verification of full arm-to-torso clearance.
Both dedicated close-ups exclude the claws. Remaining views cannot verify every front and rear claw on both feet.
Front and side views show a vertically held torso, elevated head, and hanging arms that do not support the body.
A bipedal creature with dorsal plates and a tail is recognizable, but the target's specific cranial, anatomical, shield, and tail anchors are not preserved clearly.
The dorsal forms read as overlapping flat plates; seven distinct shattered shield forms cannot be verified.
Both side views show bent leg profiles with raised heel regions and planted forefeet. The legs visibly carry substantially more mass than the short hanging arms.
